name: Droplet Search
description: A search pill that stretches open while a droplet holding the icon splits off its end.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the pill while it is empty, collapsed or open. Keep it short; the collapsed pill has room for about one word.

props.name: collapsedWidth
props.description: Width of the closed pill in pixels, including the icon.

props.name: expandedWidth
props.description: Width of the open pill in pixels. The droplet sits beyond it.

props.name: gooeyBlur
props.description: Blur radius of the liquid filter. Larger values give a longer, softer neck between the shapes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting text (uncontrolled). The pill starts open when it is not empty.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the text on every change. Escape clears it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the pill opens on focus or closes on blur while empty.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the field off and dims it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the field. Defaults to the placeholder.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the input, for form data.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Other props go to the root element.
